description:
Search about 700 real product names - Screenrove's library plus a curated list of products on
Mobbin and Refero - each with its domain and TLD, category and derived traits: naming
pattern (real-word, compound, blend, altered, suffix, prefix, acronym, alphanumeric,
person-place, brand-extension, invented), length, syllables, whether it starts with a vowel,
casing, and domain style (exact, prefixed like getX.com, suffixed like Xhq.com, domain-hack,
subdomain, partial, different). Returns stats for the whole matching set too.

Use this for naming ideas grounded in real product names: "short invented names for AI tools
on .ai", "two-syllable real-word names", "compound names in finance". Traits are heuristics
with hand-checked overrides; check trademarks and domains before using a new name.

category.description: Comma-separated categories (OR), e.g. "AI tools", "Developer tools" or "finance".

domainStyle.description: Comma-separated domain styles (OR) - exact, prefixed, suffixed, domain-hack, subdomain, partial, different.

length.description: Letters in the name (spaces and punctuation not counted) - a number or a range like 4-6, -6 or 8-.

pattern.description:
Comma-separated naming patterns (OR) - real-word, compound, blend, altered, suffix, prefix,
acronym, alphanumeric, person-place, brand-extension, invented.

q.description: Words matched against the name, domain and the product's own one-line description.

sort.description: Order of results - name, length or syllables (shortest first).

source.description: library (products Screenrove has captured) or targets (the Mobbin/Refero list).

startsWith.description: Letters the name starts with, or vowel or consonant.

syllables.description: Syllables - a number or a range like 1-2.

name: search_names

core.description: The part of the name the traits are read from

title: Search real product names and their naming patterns
